personal.title: Full Stack Developer
personal.tagline: Building modern web applications, mobile experiences, and digital solutions for businesses and startups.
personal.bio1: Hi, I'm Ömer — a Software Engineering graduate from Istanbul Aydın University, where I earned my degree studying entirely in English. Throughout my degree I built real products: web applications, mobile apps, AI-assisted tools, and embedded systems — getting hands-on with the full development process from day one, not just in theory.
personal.bio2: My experience spans frontend development, backend services, database design, and API integration. During my internship at Cabitas I worked directly on production systems — contributing to database architecture, maintaining application workflows, and collaborating in a real engineering team. I bring both a builder's instinct and an engineer's eye for quality to everything I ship.
personal.bio3: Beyond core development, I also take on digital and visual work — landing pages, branding, and catalogs. Whether a client needs a web platform, a mobile product, or a complete online presence, I handle the project end-to-end: one person, full ownership, no handoffs.

workify-ai.title: Workify AI – Task Management App
workify-ai.description: An AI-powered task and workspace management application with backend services, user authentication, and third-party API integrations.
workify-ai.longDescription: Contributed to the development of an AI-assisted productivity platform designed to streamline task and workspace management. Built and integrated backend services, implemented authentication flows, and connected third-party APIs. Validated API responses and ensured system reliability throughout development — combining engineering with a quality-first mindset.

easy-home-rent.title: Easy Home Rent – Rental Platform
easy-home-rent.description: A web-based house rental platform with user authentication, property listings, and full CRUD operations — developed as an academic project at Istanbul Aydın University.
easy-home-rent.longDescription: Designed and developed a web application for house rental management as a university project. Implemented user registration and authentication, property listing and search features, and complete CRUD operations for managing rental data. Designed application flows end-to-end and validated all major features during development to ensure functional correctness.

myfitly.title: MyFitly – Fitness & Diet App
myfitly.description: A cross-platform mobile fitness and diet tracking application with workout logging, nutrition tracking, and progress monitoring.
myfitly.longDescription: Built a mobile application for fitness and nutrition tracking as part of a hands-on mobile development course. Implemented core features including exercise logging, daily diet tracking, and progress visualization. Validated application behavior throughout development to ensure a reliable and consistent user experience across iOS and Android.

firefighting-drone.title: Firefighting Drone – Graduation Project
firefighting-drone.description: Software logic and autonomous control mechanisms for a firefighting drone, built as the graduation project at Istanbul Aydın University.
firefighting-drone.longDescription: Designed and implemented the full software system for an autonomous firefighting drone as the university graduation project. Focused on system architecture, control flow logic, and sensor integration to enable reliable autonomous operation. Conducted functional validation at each development stage to ensure system safety and correctness under simulated conditions.

iot-smart-monitoring.title: IoT Smart Monitoring Systems
iot-smart-monitoring.description: IoT-based environmental monitoring systems using sensors for real-time data collection, processing, and automated control logic.
iot-smart-monitoring.longDescription: Developed a series of IoT projects using hardware sensors for environmental data collection and monitoring. Implemented data pipelines and basic automated control logic, then verified sensor accuracy and system behavior throughout development and testing. Gained practical experience with embedded systems and real-time data flows.
